propositions: Plan-review criterion T15 requires that risky runtime mechanisms be proved via a fast out-of-loop experiment (local run, manual probe, or interactive check) BEFORE committing them into a slow automated delivery loop (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning pipeline).

T15 applies only when the mechanism is codified (automated pipeline or environment apply), the loop is slow or costly (minutes-to-hours), and correctness depends on runtime behavior unreachable by static or unit checks (boot, authentication, connection, authorization, readiness).

T15 checks require: naming the specific risky mechanism, committing to a concrete fast proof path (not vague post-deploy verification), proving before codifying the slow loop, and cleaning up only the artifacts the experiment itself created.
T10's rubric must be partitioned to exclude transient throwaway experiments from durable-infrastructure scope, preventing overlap between de-risk and production-hardening phases.
Registry, criteria-guide, and writing-a-passing-plan documentation must be regenerated to include T15 with its descriptive name and guidance.

Coach-move decision APPROVED: move 16 'out-of-loop proof' is a valid adjacent but distinct remedy capturing T15's specific approach of proving named runtime-only risks through the fastest feedback path before codifying the slow loop.
